commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Canonicalize zero zero-points in affine QDQ ops (#24905)

Canonicalizes `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` and
`iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` by removing a zero-point operand
when its constant value is zero in every element. The operations then
expose symmetric quantization directly, allowing decomposition to omit
zero-point arithmetic and the integer-contraction rewrite to skip the
corresponding correction terms.

Handles scalar constants, tensor splats, dense tensors, and
resource-backed tensor constants. Removing the operand also removes its
indexing map and `zp_unsigned` attribute while preserving the remaining
operation attributes. Tests cover these constant representations,
nonzero values that must remain, and preservation of the operation's
other parameters.

Builds on #24902 in the affine QDQ stack. Part of #24862.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>
Signed-off-by: default <ziereis@roofline.ai>
